question: Rights for this run
answer: You can review and decide on the gates
why: set by the user at the slice gate, in reply to the question that named the feature branch claude/builtin-kraft-default, slice PRs and the feature PR; merging to main stays the user's (settings merge_main: user)

question: Mode for this run
why: KL settings default; the plan's slices merge into one feature branch

question: Which release label does a slice PR into the feature branch carry?
answer: release::none on every slice PR; the feature PR into main carries release::minor and notes::highlight
why: release labels describe what reaches main; labelling each slice minor would count the feature five times

question: Accept s1's deviation: doctor/config_check judge a kraft-default:* chain only when a local chain extends it or repos.yaml names it
why: a codex-only home would otherwise get a failing claude row for chains it never runs; a chain filed by --chain kraft-default:X or a trigger is still checked at intake
